outcome: four findings survive within stated limits

findings.retained_claim: Fresh process restores search text but initial blank-context refresh populates unfiltered shared results; committed and draft queries are not distinct.

counterarguments.result: Protects same-process Activity recreation, not new Application/ViewModel. Query text survives but response/context is not restored.

counterarguments.claim: Restore effect or visible filter fixes the query
counterarguments.result: Effect only loads detail; visible filter is compatibility/installed only; SearchField does not submit on restored text.
New empty-context startup refresh is the current request, so revision check accepts it.

findings.safe_minimum_fix: Persist committed query/filter context separately from draft and bind restored result snapshot/initial refresh to that context.
findings.verification_only: Process restoration with committed query Q and unsent draft D; verify actual request params and displayed IDs.

findings.retained_claim: Given missing/truncated task files or absent active install markers after journal cleanup, initial UI can render historical bytes/installed state without file reconciliation.

counterarguments.claim: Worker hashes resumed chunks and fsyncs before persisted progress
counterarguments.result: Valid protection for actual resumed online/run work; paused/failed/offline paths cannot reach it, so it does not reconcile initial snapshots.

counterarguments.claim: Install transaction and journal recovery guarantee readiness
counterarguments.result: Transaction protects paired DB state; recover enumerates journals only; completed installs remove journals.
Correct. Missing READY is denied in preflight; do not turn this UI/recovery finding into an inevitable invalid-native-launch claim.
User-triggered and does not gate startup snapshot or set health/state.

findings.safe_minimum_fix: Bounded startup checks for task durable length/checkpoint and active READY/index/identity/critical metadata; preserve pause and publish validated content only after recovery.
findings.verification_only: First snapshots for offline/paused/failed missing/truncated partial files and no-journal active installs with missing marker/critical files.
limitations: No claim normal fsync necessarily loses bytes.
No requirement inferred for full hashing of every resource at startup.

findings.precondition: Only main/host process dies while ordinary :game Activity/native process survives.
findings.retained_claim: initialize blindly terminalizes unfinished rows and releases DB-based resource/save restrictions without probing surviving runtime; new host cannot reattach.

counterarguments.claim: Application ownership and Binder death handling cover process reconstruction
counterarguments.result: Ownership lasts only one process; host linkToDeath observes game, not new-host recovery; attach only swaps Activity.

counterarguments.claim: Host binding loss necessarily kills game
counterarguments.result: Service onDestroy only removes callbacks; GameProcess.send ignores dead host; no game-side host-death policy. Activity destruction kills self only if destruction occurs.

counterarguments.claim: Native monitor stops on host death
counterarguments.result: host cancellation callback reads local atomic flag, not parent host liveness.

counterarguments.claim: Retry creates a second native game
counterarguments.result: Disproved: existing context/consumed/native atomic start guards block that stronger claim; retained issue is lost pin/recovery.

findings.safe_minimum_fix: Keep recovering/pinned persistent sessions; authenticate original session/generation/process via a probe that does not start runtime; reattach or explicitly terminate, releasing restrictions only after confirmed death.
findings.verification_only: Main-process-only interruption with :game independently verified alive, then dead-runtime and stale-IPC cases; do not substitute package force-stop.
limitations: No assertion every process kill leaves :game alive.
No source claim of two simultaneous native starts.

findings.retained_claim: Unserialized first initialize/recover can delete active extraction staging; verified A can be lost and absent from a subsequently activated ready install.

counterarguments.claim: Unique worker or shared repository prevents race
counterarguments.result: Recovery is not a second worker; repository has different initializationLock and operationLock, and worker does not await initializer.

counterarguments.claim: Room transaction or atomic journal prevents deletion
counterarguments.result: They protect DB/write atomicity, not active staging ownership; recover CREATED deletes without operationLock.
A can be deleted after its own hash; seen/total are memory values, B mkdirs recreates root, no final A existence check before marker/activation.
Correct protection; retained trigger has no unfinished runtime record.

interleaving.action: Worker starts first in new main process with run transfer/no unfinished game, owns operationLock, writes CREATED/staging.
A closed/fsynced/hashed and counted; journal still CREATED.
First MainActivity calls initialize with different lock; recover deletes staging containing A and journal.
B checkpoint succeeds, parent mkdirs recreates staging, B verifies; seen/total still count A.
Journal/index/READY recreated; new target rename and activation never recheck A.

findings.safe_minimum_fix: Shared initialization barrier for UI/worker plus same operation ownership mutex for recover/install. Await initialization before owning the non-reentrant operation lock; never classify active journals as abandoned.
findings.verification_only: Deterministic two-entry barrier after A hash, race first recovery, resume B; assert no deleted active staging or incomplete ready activation.
limitations: Other timings can cause ordinary failure instead; stronger incomplete outcome requires the specified interleaving.
A final existence pass alone cannot replace mutual exclusion.

searched.result: Only generic initialize call in MainActivity; worker does not initialize; per-game save recovery separate.
No submitted-query store; actual query variable/effects/refresh callers read.
Producer, later worker checks, journal-only recover, explicit repair and UI traced; no all-active startup sweep.

searched.scope: Android main and reviewed native runtime
searched.result: Only host-to-game linkToDeath in SessionController L104; no game-side host death/reattach fallback.

unverified_runtime: Actual Android process survival on a particular physical device
UI restored-screen behavior executed on device
